info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Making API
info.description: The Market Making API facilitates the automated trading of securities by managing quotes and maintaining liquidity in the wholesale trading environment. This endpoint enables firms to submit market making orders efficiently, optimizing their trading strategies. Typical consumers of this API include trading firms and financial institutions aiming to enhance their trading capabilities. With robust functionalities, the Market Making API supports real-time transaction processing and ensures compliance with trading regulations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a market making order in the wholesale trading environment. By providing the necessary details, you can specify the parameters of the market making strategy, enabling dynamic trading operations.
